transcript.content: Hello, I'm glad you could make it in today. What brings you into the clinic?

Hi. Well, I came in because things have just... crashed, I guess. I've had this really drastic shift lately. 

For a while, I was just going constantly at work. I was launching nonstop plant redesign projects, calling our suppliers way after hours, and even rewriting the entire shift plan all by myself. I was just taking on everything. But then I went from doing all of that to... well, suddenly being completely unable to keep up with the very plans I had just set in motion. I just hit a wall, and it's become really hard to function.
Since hitting that wall, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

Yes, I really have. Lately, I wake up in my temporary apartment and I just have this... this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the whole day is already ruined before I even get in my car to drive to the plant. I just feel incredibly down all the time.
Have you been hearing any voices or sounds that other people around you cannot hear?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or any sounds that aren't really there.
Have you had any thoughts of wanting to end your life, or feeling that life isn't worth living?

No, I haven't. I mean... I feel completely miserable and exhausted, but I haven't had any thoughts of actually ending my life. I don't want to die, I just want this heavy feeling to go away. But no, I haven't had any suicidal thoughts.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in activities that you normally enjoy?

Not really, no. I mean... I know I just said I'm completely exhausted, so I don't always have the energy to do a lot outside of going to the plant. But I wouldn't say I've lost interest in things. When I do actually sit down to read or just watch a movie, I still enjoy it. So, no, the interest is still there.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness lately?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I know I'm capable. I do my job at the plant well and I know I have value. It's just... I'm just so incredibly tired and down right now. But no, I don't feel worthless as a person.
